chapter: Discovering jazz and playing in Berlin
title: Discovering jazz in 1954 through George Lewis books and American bands
summary: Naundorf came to jazz in 1954 through books about George Lewis, plus American radio and big bands visiting Berlin.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers

blocks.x: Tell me how long you've been interested in the Jazz?
I came to the Jazz in 1954, by George Lewis's books.
Where did you find these books? I bought them in regular regular
And that was actually the beginning.
Are you there completely wrongly? Or have you ever heard American music?

Yes, so is that. We had a lot of American music in the radio. And then came the American bands back to Berlin. Big bands, hauptsächlich. Welche bands? Duke Ellington. I was not in those days. Lionel Hampton, Woody Herman, and Joseph at the Philharmonic. Louis Armstrong. Louis Armstrong. And then saw man natürlich the letters. And it was new. They were still young.
